nodes.name: Run Discovery Refresh
nodes.notes: Requires self-hosted n8n with REPO_PATH set to monorepo root. Alternative: use GitHub Actions workflow (see .github/workflows/discovery-scrape.yml).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ completedAt: new Date().toISOString(), schedule: '12h', source: 'n8n', scrape: $json }) }}

nodes.name: Notify MVP (optional)
nodes.notes: Enable if not using --notify flag on the refresh script. Usually --notify handles this.

parameters.content:
=12h discovery refresh

1. Scrapes App Store, Play Store, Reddit, forums, social
2. Merges into raw-reviews.json
3. Normalizes → analyzes themes → validates
4. Writes data/discovery/last-refresh.json

Env: REPO_PATH, MVP_APP_URL, N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET

meta.description: Fetches latest scrape data every 12 hours: multi-source reviews → merge → normalize → theme analysis → validation.
